Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’ve made edits to the manuscript.
1\. My name appears at the top of the first page. Is it supposed to be at the top?
2\. Page numbers need to be added.
3\. I’m unable to format the title of the 9th chapter. Please take a look at it.
4\. Please also review the remaining chapter titles, subtitles, and Table of Content.
